HADESANCIENTS-HEPHAESTUS_ANCIENT.title: Hephaestus
HADESANCIENTS-HEPHAESTUS_ANCIENT.talk.AN: Don't sweat it, you'll be as good as new here in a bit.
Oi witchie, let me see about that hunk of metal you got there.
You still alive, witchie? Here, this ought to keep it that way.
Just clanking away as always, though let's do some clanking now on your behalf.
Reckon you're looking for another tune-up, no problem at all.
No charge per usual, I'll just throw it on tab and some point Dad'll pick it up.
So you got a bit of metal I could effortlessly bend to my will or something?
I just had the strongest urge to bang on solid metal for a bit.
Oi, you're about due for another servicing appointment on that thing.
You got a dangerous line of work, witchie. Though I can get you some protection here.
How's it going and the like, all good? All good, that's great, now here.
Eugh, it's been an awful lot of late! Don't sweat it, though. Always got room for you.
Ehh, think I got just the thing to help you with the killing-and-not-dying here, witchie.
You know, the more I work those weapons, the more intricacies I can find...
I don't normally just give away my services, but it ain't normally of late.
Say, what's that you got there, witchie, a nice weapon of some sort?
Ehh, fancy meeting you again and all, now let me get to work.
I always said a bit of evening work is good for you, witchie.
Only so much I can do when you're out and about with that walking stick, you know.
Ehh, it's that staff again... well, mayhap I can do something about the knots at least.
Fine couple of knives you got there, witchie. Though let's make 'em proper vicious here.
Hold up those flashy blades of yours for me and I'll have 'em sharper than ever.
Ahh, brought my favorite out to play, did you? Just needs a tune-up and you'll be all set.
Who needs witchery when you can go on brandishing an axe like that?
Bringing a couple flaming sticks to a fight? Well, whatever works, witchie.
Ehh, turns out torches ain't just for lighting your way! Let's see 'em here.
All sorts of silver I can work with in that skull of yours, so put 'er up!
Ohh, right sinister choice of weapon you got there, witchie.
Soon as I'm through, you go knock some sense into some wretches for me, would you?
HADESANCIENTS-HEPHAESTUS_ANCIENT.talk.fi: Oi, you that new cousin of mine? They told me you needed a weapon or something? Bah! You already got one! Right lousy one, can spot that piss-poor workmanship from here. Though, I could tune it up...
